label_definition: Observed user-days within official insiders.csv start/end dates (inclusive). Window labels, not event-level maliciousness.

feature_notes.bytes_transferred_mb: External-recipient email size in MiB; NOT total network exfiltration.
feature_notes.session_duration_min: Daily first-to-last observed event span; NOT exact session duration.
feature_notes.login_hour: First logon hour in day; missing when no logon.
feature_notes.unavailable: No invented sensitive-file labels, failed-login counts or privilege levels.
feature_notes.off_hours_events: Events before 08:00 or at/after 18:00; fixed research assumption.
